All New 2024!

Stayed here for a bachelorette party and was easily the cutest Airbnb we’ve ever been! It looked exactly like the pictures and had everything we could have needed. If we’re ever in Scottsdale we would love to stay again! Thank you to the hosts for having everything set up so beautifully and being so responsive!
This home was perfect for my bachelorette party! It was everything I could’ve asked for and more. The bridal suite house was an additional perk!!
The perfect home for a girls trip.
Great experience and amazing home 10/10 would stay again :)

This house was in a GREAT location! We were able to walk to shops and coffee bars and all the hopping spots were a short 5-10 minute Uber away! Outdoor space was great for hosting a Bachelorette and the rooms were very spacious. Our group had a blast and we would absolutely recommend this to another group of girls!
